steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Mr. Dalton! You really got that extra scene for me! And it's a wire stunt to boot?

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: How did you get Director Quay to agree so easily, when he wouldn't budge when I asked him?

steps.name: Dalton
steps.text: Greta personally recruited me as lead actor. Steven wouldn't dare turn down my requests.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: This is my first time in a wire rig... I'll never forget this opportunity you gave me! Okay, I have to go prepare now!

steps.name: Dalton
steps.text: Sure, go on.

steps.name: Dalton
steps.text: Now you're acting all humble? Might've even fooled me, if I didn't already know you were trying to get Steven to mess with my role behind my back.

spans.text: you're acting all humble? Might've even fooled me, if I didn't already know you were trying to get Steven to mess with my role behind my back.

steps.name: Dalton
steps.text: First time in a wire rig, huh... Good to hear.

steps.name: Dalton
steps.text: Rookies should know their places. Now you'll be a good sport and take it, right? Even if you're left hanging for hours?

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Shelly! I just got another scene and I need the wire rig. Can you prepare it for me?

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: I know you're passionate about acting. But how many extra scenes is this now? Do you even realize how much you've screwed with the schedule I made for the entire crew?

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Do you feel even an ounce of guilt, Princess? I'm not changing the entire schedule again because of you. This crew doesn't revolve around you.

spans.text: Do you feel even an ounce of guilt,
? I'm not changing the entire schedule again because of you. This crew doesn't revolve around you.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: I'm sorry, Shelly. I'm not trying to increase your workload, honest. But Mr. Dalton said the director signed off on it...

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Dalton did?

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: Alright then.

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Thanks, Shelly!

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: (He was just telling me how you have no respect for your seniors in the field. No way did he do this out of pure kindness.)

steps.name: Shelly
steps.text: (The wire rig, huh?)

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Hello, Laura! You look wonderful today! Not many actors would be so happy to do an aerial stunt!

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Well, I've never been so excited! This scene will be the only one in the movie that belongs entirely to me. I want to knock it out of the ballpark!

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Well, aren't you just adorable?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Try not to get hurt though. And if you're tired, you can always come find me in my room. I'll be there all night...

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: Oh, Marion! Have you come to touch up Michael's makeup?

steps.name: Laura
steps.text: I have to go prepare. See you later!

steps.name: Marion
steps.text: Yeah, see you in hell, bitch!

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: D-Don't be angry with me, Mari.

steps.name: Marion
steps.text: I look away for one moment and you're flirting with another woman! Are you tired of me already?

steps.name: Marion
steps.text: You've been making eyes at her on the set too... If you like younger women that much, how about you let her do your makeup from now on?

spans.text: You've been making eyes at her on the set too... If you like younger women that much, how about you let
do your makeup from now on?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Please, babe, I'm serious about you.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: I won't talk to her from now on, I swear!

steps.name: Marion
steps.text: ...You swear?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: I swear!

steps.name: Marion
steps.text: I'm familiar with your vices by now, but this is an important time for your career. Don't screw it up, and don't let me down.

steps.name: Marion
steps.text: That Laura girl is a loud-mouthed show-off. I'm sure she's up to something. You can do better.

steps.name: Marion
steps.text: Keep your distance from her.

steps.name: Marion
steps.text: No talking to her, and no physical contact. Even if she's dying right in front of you, that's none of your business... got it?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Babe?
He can tell from Marion's eyes that she is not joking.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Alright, I promise.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: It's still not my turn? What's going on?

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: There's something on Mr. Dalton's end, and everyone on the set's gone over. No one's giving orders now... Look, we've even got that rookie still hanging up there.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Oh, poor thing.

steps.name: Staff
steps.text: You never struck me as the compassionate type. Trying to get her in bed?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Hey, you know me.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Let me go check on our poor little beauty...

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: I promised Mari this morning that I wouldn't approach her, but...

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: We never said anything about her coming to me, right?
Michael looks up and sees Laura's slender frame hanging in mid-air. Her dripping sweat has formed a small puddle on the floor.
She is tired, but her eyes remain strong, stinging Michael's frivolous heart.
The wire rig is creaking. From experience, Michael can tell there is something wrong with it.
However—

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: All the better for me, yeah?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: She'll call for help once she realizes something's not right.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: I'll be her hero and have the perfect excuse for a little tête-à-tête, all without breaking my promise to Mari.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: I'll let her hang a little longer.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Why aren't you calling for help, Laura? I'm right here, you know!

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: It's been hours, and the rope's sounding increasingly off... Where did this equipment even come from? How could it be so ancient?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Is that a crack around the belt? She has to have noticed that!

spans.text: Is that a crack around the belt? She

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: No, I have to tell her, I have to...
He walks forward, stepping in the puddle of sweat. The heat of the limelight is causing Laura to become dehydrated.
Michael will never understand her determination, her passion. It is as though she is denying everything he is.

steps.name: Marion
steps.text: Ahem.
Michael turns around to find Marion standing in the far corner, gazing at him and the exhausted actress with cold eyes.
'Even if she's dying right in front of you, that's none of your business... got it?'
Michael strokes his orange ears and stops in his tracks.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: ...Well, it really is none of my business if she chooses to suffer.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: That's your first lesson, Laura.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Never be too serious. Always put yourself first, even if you have to hurt others. That's the most important thing—
Creak, creak.
The rope above his head is being stretched to its limit.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: You're still not going to call for help?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Aaaahhhhhh—!!

steps.name: Marion
steps.text: Michael?

steps.name: Marion
steps.text: What's going on? What were you thinking about?

steps.name: Marion
steps.text: I came with you to the makeup room for an explanation, not to watch you melt down.

steps.name: Marion
steps.text: What did Moira mean when she said you wanted to leave the plate?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: We have to get out of here, babe!

a.text: Victoria's famous Crimson Troupe is here in Daremont for three days! Don't miss it!

steps.name: Troupe Leader
steps.text: It's the first time you've left the castle and traveled so far with the troupe, isn't it?

steps.name: Young Lucian
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Troupe Leader
steps.text: Are you nervous?

steps.name: Young Lucian
steps.text: ...I'm fine, Master.

steps.name: Young Lucian
steps.text: The others are playing the leads. I'm just a very minor role, watching from the side in most of my scenes...

steps.name: Troupe Leader
steps.text: When the true performance unfolds before your eyes, it is not easy to resist the urge to run.

steps.name: Troupe Leader
steps.text: You've learned another lesson today, child.

a.text: Police statement on the Daremont Case:
At this time, there is no evidence linking the case to the Crimson Troupe which passed through the area recently. The police has established a special task force to investigate.

steps.text: A spire in Lupukarn, Leithanien

steps.name: Troupe Leader
steps.text: (Claps)

steps.name: Troupe Leader
steps.text: A splendid performance.

steps.name: Troupe Leader
steps.text: You've finally made a breakthrough after your first performance as the lead.

steps.name: Troupe Leader
steps.text: The tiny black crystal on your neck is almost perfectly hidden. The audience sees only the glamorous star, not the Infected approaching death one step at a time.

steps.name: Troupe Leader
steps.text: Your performance is increasingly mature, and your songs move the passions. There is virtually no stiffness, no pretentiousness.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Are you complimenting me?

steps.name: Troupe Leader
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Troupe Leader
steps.text: Are you not going? Or do you want to stay, and take in the aftertaste of the stage?

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Aftertaste?

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: You mean the taste of blood?

steps.name: Innocent Child
steps.text: Excuse me, Mister, please let me through.

steps.name: Innocent Child
steps.text: I want to go home.

steps.name: Troupe Leader
steps.text: I think the Crimson Troupe can take her in.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Take her in?

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: She doesn't know that her home is gone. She doesn't know that some of the people before her still have her family's blood on them...

steps.name: Troupe Leader
steps.text: That is what we'd call a fateful encounter, is it not?

steps.name: Troupe Leader
steps.text: As it was with you and the Troupe.

steps.name: Troupe Leader
steps.text: Perhaps you should teach her yourself. Teach her how to blend in, how to embrace a new life... how to walk the path that you have.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: The show goes on, even once we've left the stage?

steps.name: Troupe Leader
steps.text: Ah, you remember what I said.

steps.name: Troupe Leader
steps.text: Yes, there is no drama like life. The aesthetics of destiny are never bound by any medium.

steps.name: Innocent Child
steps.text: ...Mister?

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: What do you think, Lucian?

steps.name: Abyss
steps.text: Have you decided? You're in a position to make a choice now, aren't you?

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: Are you awake?

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: (Lazy yawn)

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: The bitterness of obsession... your emotions.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: A challenge to the palate?

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: I wouldn't say that.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: But your flashbacks have become increasingly frequent since we came to this plate.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: That means we're getting closer to him.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: You noticed the strangeness of that coordinator.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: As did you.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Unfortunately, she was visited by tragedy before I could extract any more clues.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: You used that camera assistant to break the news of the Catastrophe?

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: It was too much a coincidence for that document to show up when it did, the way it did.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: When one's been in enough plays, it's not hard to realize that such an obvious clue is bound to be a trigger.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Dalton's death was only the beginning.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: The plot devices have been set, and their developments foreshadowed. The curtain has been raised, and it cannot be lowered again.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: And the author will not appear until the story reaches the climax.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: ...Only then can I kill him.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: (Yawn)

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: Be careful, Lucian.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: What I mean is, be careful of yourself.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: As I said, your emotions are filled with the bitterness of obsession... It's a dangerous thing.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: I apologize, Miss.Christine.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: You will not have to endure it for long.
